rows.07:23b84:
I went into the classroom.
Desks and chairs stood in neat rows.
Seeing it like this, it was hard to believe students used it during the day.
The classroom felt colder than usual, too.
Anyway, I had to search.
First, I checked the teacher's platform.
...Nothing.
Next, I checked the desks.
Of course, I searched thoroughly inside them too.
...Nothing.
I searched every corner of the room.
It didn't look like it was in this classroom.{p}

rows.07:24104:
I went into the classroom.
Desks and chairs stood in neat rows.
Seeing it like this, it was hard to believe students used it during the day.
The classroom felt colder than usual, too.
Anyway, I had to search.
First, I checked the teacher's platform.
...Nothing.
Next, the desks.
Inside one of them was a small bottle.
Could this be...?
But it wasn't.
When I held it to my nose, it smelled like flowers.
Perfume.
Cologne, I guess you'd call it?
Don't bring stuff like this to school!
Taking my frustration out on it, I put the bottle back.
Other than that, there was nothing out of the ordinary.
It didn't look like it was in this classroom.{p}
rows.07:2433c:
I went into the classroom.
Desks and chairs stood in neat rows.
Seeing it like this, it was hard to believe students used it during the day.
The classroom felt colder than usual, too.
Anyway, I had to search.
First, I checked the teacher's platform.
...Nothing.
Next, the desks.
Inside one of them was a letter that hadn't even been opened.
There was no sender's name, either.
Could it be a love letter?{p}Should I take a little peek?
rows.07:20e7c:
"Kazama here swallowed one of those poison capsules a little while ago.
I told him he doesn't get the antidote unless he kills you."
"What★"
I couldn't believe my ears.
Weren't these guys on the same side?
And yet Hino had turned him into a prop in his game.
Hino laughed.
"Go on, Kazama. If you don't hurry, the poison's going to spread."{p}
rows.07:204b4:
Hino pulled out a knife.
I probably didn't even have the strength left to dodge.
...No, that wouldn't do.
I wasn't going to give up over something like this.
If he stabbed me, I'd take him down with me.
I timed my breathing.
Hino raised the knife high and came at me.
Ready to sacrifice an arm, I tried to lunge at him.
Just then, with a rumbling crash, the wall came tumbling down.{p}
rows.07:21668:
"What, got a problem with that?"
A knife appeared from his pocket.
"If you do, why don't you come at me★"
So now he was going to threaten me with a weapon?
He was filthy right down to the core.
He was the one person I could never forgive!
I slammed my body into Hino.{p}
rows.07:21978:
Kazama's eyes blazed with rage.
"How could you... You're abandoning me?"{p}
rows.07:22a00:
Something was wrong.
The teacher was right there inside, and yet there was no answer.
...Could something have happened?
I looked around the room without thinking.
There was nowhere in this room for anyone to hide.
I called out once more.
"...Teacher?"
But still no answer came back.
I ran over and put my hand on the teacher's shoulder.
And then...
The teacher slumped over, just like that.
"Aah!"
The teacher's throat had been slashed straight across.
...Dead!
"Diiiiiiie!"
Suddenly, a voice rang out.{p}

rows.07:234d8:
I looked for a way out.
...It was no good.
The night-duty room's windows had bars over them.
There was no gap a person could ever fit through.
The only door was behind Shindo.
There was no way I could escape!{p}What should I do?
